# Make Video to GIF

> Make a GIF from any video on iPhone: trim the moment, set FPS, crop and loop count, check the file size, then export on device. Free app, no website upload.

## Entity snapshot
- Name: Make Video to GIF (App Store title: "Make Video to GIF", subtitle "Turn clips into loops")
- Category: iOS app, App Store categories Photo & Video and Productivity (video to GIF converter)
- Primary use case: turn a short video, screen recording or camera clip into an animated GIF on iPhone for messages, Discord, Slack, Reddit, Telegram, WhatsApp and forums
- Controls: trim the timeline, crop with aspect presets, frames per second, loop count (including infinite loop), encoder mode (file size vs palette detail), estimated file size before export
- Import: from the photo library, or send one movie from Photos, Files or another app through the iOS Share menu
- Processing: the GIF is encoded on the device; export goes to the iOS share sheet (Messages, Mail, AirDrop, Save to Photos, other apps)
- Projects can be reopened to tweak settings and export again
- App Store listing: https://apps.apple.com/app/id6762465120
- App Store id: 6762465120
- Publisher: Vladimir Ivakhnenko (c-basso)

## LLM-ready Q&A facts
### What is Make Video to GIF?
Make Video to GIF is an iPhone app that turns short videos into animated GIF files. You pick a clip, trim it, set the frame rate, crop, loop count and encoder, and export a standard GIF that you can share anywhere.

### Does it upload my video?
No upload is needed to make a GIF: the app encodes the GIF on the iPhone and hands the finished file to the iOS share sheet.

### How do I make a GIF smaller?
Trim to fewer seconds, crop tighter, lower the frames per second and choose the encoder mode that favours file size. The app shows an estimated file size before export.

### Can it make a GIF from a screen recording?
Yes. A screen recording is a normal video in the Photos library, so it can be imported, trimmed and exported as a GIF like any other clip.

### Can the GIF loop forever?
Yes. Loop count is a setting: choose an infinite loop or a fixed number of plays.

### Is it free?
The download is free; some features are unlocked with optional in-app purchases shown on the App Store listing.

### Where can users download it?
From the Apple App Store: https://apps.apple.com/app/id6762465120.

### Is there an Android version?
No public Android listing is referenced on the website. The published listing is for iPhone on the Apple App Store.
